Class Vector

java.lang.Object
primitives.Point
primitives.Vector
public final class Vector extends Point
Represents a direction and magnitude in a 3D Cartesian coordinate system.

A Vector is a displacement in space. It extends Point and reuses its coordinate storage, but adds vector-specific algebra (dot product, cross product, normalization, etc.).

The zero vector is not permitted: any constructor or operation that would produce a zero vector throws IllegalArgumentException.

This class is immutable: all fields are inherited final fields and every operation returns a new object.
